title: Russian Drone Strikes Kill 6 Across Ukraine, Including Bus Attack in Kherson
detail: Russian forces launched drone attacks across multiple Ukrainian regions on August 19, killing at least 6 people and injuring 12. In the front-line city of Kherson, a Russian drone struck a bus at 8:50 a.m. local time, killing 4 people and wounding 4 others; a separate drone strike on a car in the city killed 1 more person and wounded 1. In Zaporizhzhia region, a Russian strike killed 1 person and injured 7. Russia's Defence Ministry said 453 Ukrainian drones were downed overnight in various regions.

title: Ukrainian Drones Strike Sverdlov Explosives Plant in Russia's Dzerzhinsk
detail: Ukrainian long-range drones struck the Sverdlov explosives plant in Dzerzhinsk, Nizhny Novgorod region, overnight into August 19, sparking a large fire and thick smoke over the city. The century-old defense-chemical facility is one of Russia's largest explosives producers and is sanctioned by the US, UK, EU, Japan, and Switzerland; it was previously struck on April 30, 2026. Separately, Ukrainian strikes killed a civilian in Shebekinsky district, Belgorod region, and a woman was killed by Russian fire in Donetsk, with 18 people injured across the front in the prior 24 hours.
